resolution: Added RJIT_COLLIDERLOG — a no-V8 collision diagnostic (the user plays ONLY the compiled game; the JS path is too laggy, so console.log is unavailable). Mirrors the existing RJIT_STAIRLOG: set RJIT_COLLIDERLOG=1 and the Zig sim prints, per frame the player moves or stands inside a collider, how many solid colliders are LOADED (rects+oriented), how many the player capsule currently OVERLAPS (inside=N), the nearest edge, and the side-push that fired. inside=0 next to a visible prop = no collider was baked (bake bug); inside>0 with push~0 while moving = a collider exists but is not stopping you (resolution/band bug), tagged 'WALKING THROUGH'. playerSolidOverlaps reuses the exact band test (feet<top, head>floor) + circle-vs-AABB the real side-push uses, un-rotating oriented rects about their pivot, so the readout matches what collision sees. Purely additive (79 lines, gated → zero cost off). Host compiles (zig build test-game-physics 41/42; the 1 ramp-ascent failure pre-exists in f11187303, unrelated — my code is inert unless the env var is set). Usage: rebuild, run the compiled game with RJIT_COLLIDERLOG=1, walk into a prop, read the [colliderlog] lines to see whether props bake colliders at all.
